description: This source file defines functions to construct various configurations of battery models with hierarchical modules, cells, and contact resistances, including different structural arrangements and degradation settings. It references external modules for cells, modules, procedures, and settings, and implements multiple 'makeBattery' functions for different battery architectures.

methods.name: makeBattery
methods.description: Constructs a hierarchical battery model with 20s cells, 15 modules in string, 9 strings in battery, with options for balancing, spread variations, contact resistance, and cooling control.

methods.name: makeBattery2
methods.description: Constructs an alternative battery configuration with 9p, 15s, 20s structure, with similar options as above.

methods.name: makeBattery_EPFL_smaller
methods.description: Creates a smaller EPFL-style battery with modules of 20s 6p, 15 modules per rack, 9 racks, with resistance multiplier RM.

methods.name: makeBattery_EPFL
methods.description: Builds a standard EPFL battery structure with 20s 6p modules, 15 modules per rack, 9 racks, with resistance multiplier RM.

methods.name: makeBattery_Test
methods.description: Creates a test battery with a specific configuration for testing purposes.

methods.name: makeBattery_TestParallel
methods.description: Creates a parallel test battery configuration with specific structure and parameters.
